note: Identities, statutory citations and legal-use metadata only. No symbol artwork is in this repository, and asset_status says so for every entry. Civic symbols are never AI-generated; they are acquired from the issuing authority or an equivalently verifiable source, one at a time, when a scene actually needs the bytes.
